scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./package.json', 'utf8')); const v = { version: pkg.version + '.' + Date.now(), timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }; fs.writeFileSync('./public/version.json', JSON.stringify(v, null, 2)); if (fs.existsSync('./dist')) fs.writeFileSync('./dist/version.json', JSON.stringify(v, null, 2));"
